item.tib: khro bo dbang chen ngo mtshar rgyas pa'i rnams bshad gsal ba'i sgron ma
item.coloph: gsang 'dus la sogs sgrab gshen nyer bzhi'i/ thugs kyi bcud phyung a dkar theg pa'i bon/ tshe 'di 'am ni gsum la mi 'da' bar/ phyag rgya chen po rig 'dzin sar slebs byed/ thabs shes bdud rtsi'i 'byung dug phung po bcas/ lha sku rig stobs ye shes sgyur ba'i gzhung / ci bzhin bsgrub min bsgrub par nus min kyang / dbang chen rnams (rnam) bshad gsal sgron 'di bshad pas/ lhag chad nor sogs nyes par gyur sogs dang*/ zab mo'i gnas de gsang sgrogs gyur te kun/ 'gying rngams (rngam) sprul pa'i sde dang dbal mo'i tshogs/ smin skyong ma rgyun tshogs la bdag rgyud mthol/ sngags kyi rgyal theb rgyal gshen la bshad gser/ tshang rgyung gnas 'dir gnas pa'i nyi zla'am/ gangs can khrod 'dir gangs ri ltar mtho ba'i/ rgyal gshen mched gnyis rgyal srid bde ba nas/ legs pa'i gsung ltar gsung rab 'di bzhengs pas/ dge ba gang yin gang dag yon mchod slob/ 'phral gyi rkyen zhi zhi bde'i gong 'phang slebs/ yun gyi sgrib byang byang chub mchog rnyed shog gsung rab 'di ni shin tu zab bka'i gsung/ gtad rgya 'di ni brtan pa lha dgur gtad/ spyod tshul 'di u ya'i lugs bzhin spyod/ bshig (bshigs) 'dral byed de bdud rgyal ltar du bshig(bshigs/)spyi spungs dbang chen rgyas pa'i rnam bshad gsal ba'i sgron me 'di ni/ 'dzam gling bod kyi gnas 'dir/ nyi zla'i 'khor lo ltar gsal zhing dbang sgyar ba'i bdag nyid/ btsan la'i rgyal gshen chen po/ mched nang chen dpal ldan pa dang dpon chen po g.yung drung 'bum gnyis kyi thugs bzhed rgyas pa dang / rin chen dar zab la sogs 'byor ba'i longs spyod/ bsod nams tshogs kyi gter du sgyar ba'i phyir du/ skyabs kyi ston pa rin chen 'od zer gyis/ sgo gsum 'bad pa'i sgo nas lhun gyi grub pa'i khang bzang du bris pa dge'o/ des kyang bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du/ phan bde rgya chen por 'byung bar gyur cig bkra shis dge'o//
